privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data ZARASOA collects, why, how long it is kept and how to exercise your rights.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data?
paragraphs: ZARASOA is a university platform that brings together courses, learning resources and assignments. The data controller is the educational institution that operates the platform (the “administration”).
For any question about your data, use the contact shown at the bottom of this page.

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: At registration: last name, first name, email address, student number, password and, if you provide them, nickname, phone number and date of birth.
At sign-in: IP address, browser type and number of failed sign-in attempts, used to secure your account.
While using the service: the assignments you submit and actions related to your account (approval, suspension…).
Your password is never stored in clear text and cannot be read by the administration.

sections.title: Why we use it
paragraphs: To create and approve your student account from your student number.
To give you access to the content of your field, track and level, and let you submit assignments.
To protect accounts: an account is locked after 5 consecutive failed sign-ins.
To measure site audience, only if you accept measurement cookies.

sections.title: Legal basis
paragraphs: Processing your registration and sign-in data is necessary to provide the service you request.
Audience measurement is based on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

sections.title: Hosting and recipients
paragraphs: Your data is hosted by Supabase (database and authentication). It is accessible to the administration; learning content is accessible to your teachers according to their rights.
Your data is not sold and is not used for advertising.

sections.title: Retention
paragraphs: Your data is kept as long as your account exists. When the account is closed, it is deleted or anonymised, unless a legal retention obligation applies.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: Essential (no consent needed): sign-in session cookies, the language cookie (NEXT_LOCALE), and display (light or dark theme) and cookie preferences stored in your browser.
Audience measurement (with consent): if you click “Accept” in the banner, anonymous visit statistics are collected. If you refuse, nothing is set.
You can change your choice at any time with the “Manage cookies” link at the bottom of the page.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask for access to your data, its correction or deletion, or object to its processing.
To exercise these rights, contact the administration (contact at the bottom of the page).

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: Exchanges are encrypted (HTTPS), passwords are protected, secret keys are never exposed in the browser and accounts are locked after repeated failures.
No system is infallible: if an incident affects your data, you would be informed.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: This policy may change. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By creating an account or using ZARASOA, you accept the terms below.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: ZARASOA is a university platform to browse courses and learning resources and to submit assignments online.

sections.title: Registration and access
paragraphs: Registration is reserved for students with a student number. After you confirm your email address, the administration approves or rejects your request before any access is granted.
The information you provide must be accurate. A student number may only be used by the person it belongs to.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for the activity on your account.
After 5 consecutive failed sign-ins the account is locked; contact the administration to unlock it.

sections.title: Rules of use
paragraphs: You must not share your account, try to access data not intended for you, disrupt the service or upload unlawful, malicious or fraudulent content (including plagiarism).
Assignments must be submitted before the deadline set by the teacher.

sections.title: Content
paragraphs: Courses and resources remain the property of their authors. They are for personal educational use and must not be distributed without permission.
You remain the owner of your assignments; you allow ZARASOA to store them and make them available to your teachers and the administration.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: We do our best to keep the service available but do not guarantee uninterrupted access: maintenance interruptions are possible.

sections.title: Suspension
paragraphs: The administration may suspend or close an account if these terms are not respected.

sections.title: Personal data
paragraphs: How your data is processed is described in the privacy policy.

sections.title: Changes and governing law
paragraphs: These terms may be amended; continuing to use the service means you accept them. They are governed by the law applicable in the institution's country.
